basics.name: Shruti Jain
basics.label: MS Computer Vision, Carnegie Mellon University

work.name: AIRLab, Carnegie Mellon University
highlights: Developed a multimodal medical triaging pipeline for the DARPA Triage Challenge using RGB and thermal UAV imagery to predict 50+ hierarchical medical labels.
Built a two-stage system combining conditional diffusion-based RGB-to-IR generation and VLM fine-tuning with LoRA/GRPO optimization to improve triage reasoning under limited paired RGB–IR data.
Designed an agentic reasoning pipeline leveraging Vision-Language Models for real-time casualty assessment from drone footage.

work.name: Carnegie Mellon University
highlights: Worked on iterative prompt optimization with few-shot images to improve out-of-distribution object detection on large-scale multi-modal language models.
Benchmarked Qwen3-VL for object detection across three settings: class-name prompting, detailed instruction prompting, and few-shot image prompting.
Developed DetPO, a gradient-free black-box prompt optimization framework achieving up to 9.7% improvement over prior approaches on Roboflow20-VL and LVIS.

work.name: Palo Alto Networks
highlights: Built features and APIs for microservices (Java Spring Boot) to ingest events from tenant cloud accounts (AWS, Azure, GCP) for near real-time threat detection using AI.
Integrated a scheduler-worker service for polling cloud accounts using a job management framework based on SQS Queue and Redis cache.
Contributed to a high-throughput, fault-tolerant cloud security pipeline serving enterprise customers across multiple cloud providers.

work.name: Robotics Research Centre, IIIT Hyderabad
highlights: Achieved a 14.4% average decrease in mean absolute scores across 3 datasets compared to SOTA for semantic segmentation in adverse weather conditions for autonomous driving.
Implemented a differentiable visual and latent prompting mechanism to fine-tune the Segment Anything Model via adaptors and learnable image pre-processing blocks.
Constructed parallel and serial adaptor architectures to generate visual and latent prompts for robust out-of-distribution segmentation.

work.name: Nest Labs, Worcester Polytechnic Institute
highlights: Laid the groundwork for increasing the efficiency of Ant Colony Optimization for solving the Travelling Salesman Problem by learning better features with Deep Learning.
Designed and implemented a feature extraction pipeline in Python combining classical combinatorial optimization with learned neural representations.

work.name: AI and Robotics Lab (AIRL), IISc Bangalore
highlights: Worked on Zero-Shot Object Detection (ZSOD), enabling recognition and localization of unknown objects using textual descriptions by synthesizing unseen features with GANs.
Integrated ZSOD with Continual Learning to enable incremental unseen class learning without catastrophic forgetting.
Developed and benchmarked the pipeline across standard zero-shot detection datasets.

work.name: Advect Systems – Printerverse
highlights: Developed a lightweight pipeline to detect failed 3D prints in real time using image processing techniques with OpenCV and anomaly detection in Python.
Designed the system for efficient deployment on embedded hardware with minimal latency, enabling real-time feedback during the print process.

work.name: Project MANAS
highlights: Contributed to the AI team of Manipal's autonomous driving team, working on perception and computer vision modules for a self-driving vehicle.
Worked on sensor fusion and localization using LiDAR point clouds, and on real-time object detection pipelines for the autonomous driving stack.
Participated in the AUVSI SUAS competition, achieving autonomous detection and classification of aerial markers with 55% shape accuracy and 75% character accuracy.
Served as the AI/CS Expertise Head at Research Society MIT, an organization promoting undergraduate research across technical domains.
Organized workshops, reading groups, and research mentorship sessions to help undergraduate students get started with AI and computer vision research.
Coordinated interdisciplinary research initiatives and helped members publish their first research papers.
